observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, giving this batch-size-10 optimizer just 29 synchronized feedback rounds in which to turn sparse scores into coordinated de novo search; unproductive latent motion, premature convergence to one decoded basin, or invalid and duplicate decodes can consume those rounds without finding an exceptional terminal molecule.
hypothesis: Freeze a task-agnostic randomized-to-canonical SMILES translation autoencoder trained only on the unlabeled corpus, encode the ten fixed scored molecules as ten persistent latent particles, and optimize each objective by batch-synchronous Molecule Swarm Optimization: retain each particle's position, velocity, and personal-best memory, move it with inertia plus stochastic attraction toward its personal best and the current and historical swarm-best evaluated positions, and decode one fresh valid unique molecule de novo from every updated particle so oracle feedback directly steers later interacting trajectories without a surrogate.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic sequence-to-sequence molecular autoencoder on randomized and canonicalized SMILES views of the allowed unlabeled corpus, then freeze its encoder and decoder. At the start of each independent objective session, encode the ten fixed scored initial molecules as ten persistent particles with latent velocities and personal-best memories. After every oracle response, update the personal and swarm-best memories, move each particle by the Molecular Swarm Optimization rule combining inertia with stochastic attraction toward its own best and the swarm's current and historical best positions, and decode one fresh valid unique molecule from each resulting trajectory for the next announced batch. Oracle scores therefore steer interacting de novo latent trajectories directly, without fitting a surrogate or selecting from the corpus, and the 290 adaptive calls are concentrated on finding an exceptional terminal molecule for final Top-1.
